paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.01% on average, with DAX strongest (+1.51%) and Nasdaq weakest (-2.00%). Brent crude changed -5.86% to 109.02. Gold changed -3.19% to 3,909.5. Bitcoin changed -4.31% to 77,765.3125. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.929%, a relative move of -1.18%. Among the firms tracked, Evercore (+15.33%) and Santander (-11.77%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: CD&R pursues buyout of $40bn card processor Global Payments (FT Markets). Deal for US company would rank among largest buyouts in history Deals and capital markets: TPG pursues $5bn acquisition of UK data centre group Ark (FT Companies). US private capital group in talks with Elliott over what would be among the booming sector’s biggest deals this year Central banks and macro: Bank of Japan says 2% inflation goal reached after decades of deflation (FT World). Japanese central bank holds interest rates as expectations mount for December increase Central banks and macro: Fed holds fire on interest rates despite intensifying inflation (FT World). Central bank to vote on monetary policy seven times next year in shift from decades-old custom of having eight such meetings Geopolitics and trade: European oil majors lift buybacks as Iran war drives bumper profits (FT Markets).
